origin: The approved epic allocated the original 40 slots as eight in each of five groups, without named executable cases or a passing baseline. PV-01 freezes those slots here; the twelve named PV-13 sanitation slots are additive.

requirements.E1: Encrypted evidence and sanitized work before durable write
requirements.E2: Ordinary readers cannot disclose sealed source-only content
requirements.E3: Explicit scoped unexpired diagnostic capability and content-free audit
requirements.E4: Inspectable separate retention; immediate access denial at expiry
requirements.E5: Complete scoped fenced live erasure and non-resurrection; honest boundaries
requirements.E6: Honest verified migration, fixed-input encryption parity and separate sealed quality
requirements.E7: Usable local policy/status/unlock and key-loss/backup limits
requirements.E8: Sanitizer before all content side effects; report coverage and benign damage
requirements.E9: Immutable scoped policy snapshots and authoritative fences; hosted owns controls

execution_contract.layout_counting: Both DuckDB layouts are required subchecks where storage artifacts differ, recorded inside each case; never replace a failed layout with another or count it as a new passing scenario.
execution_contract.providers: Deterministic local fakes or fixed existing extraction artifacts; zero new live/paid model calls. Real pinned local recognizers run supported detector fixtures in PV-13.
execution_contract.clock: Fixed fake clock; advance to exact deadlines without sleeps.
execution_contract.results: No runtime results in this contract ticket. Each execution later records case/backend/layout, fixture checksum, code/library versions, command/log, status, observed outcome and any failure.
execution_contract.marker_contract: Each relevant fixture has distinct source-only and deliberately admitted markers. Sealed prohibited sinks must contain neither raw source-only markers nor removed prohibited values; intentionally admitted allowed facts are tested separately. Scan all inventory logical copies plus applicable log/temp/export artifacts after success, failure and restart. Ciphertext at rest is allowed; plaintext absence alone does not prove physical erasure.

storage_parity.selection: Freeze 24 existing retrieval queries and their fixture hashes before baseline capture. Same sanitized admitted input/policy, fixed clock before expiry, same keys/versions except storage transformation.
storage_parity.expected: Identical selected record IDs/order and packed text before/after byte-preserving encryption/migration. Keep unsanitized baseline and report sanitation-induced differences separately.

sealed_behavior.expected: Required admitted facts/qualifiers survive; source-only questions report unavailable. Report standard/sealed differences without a benchmark equivalence claim.

separate_quality_sets.budget: PV-11 owns one baseline capture and one final run, plus at most two targeted repairs per behavior. No new universal retrieval-default evaluation is authorized here.

cases.title: Profile and explicit lifetime inspection
cases.setup: Admit a fixed fact under each valid standard, sealed and no-evidence policy; inspect effective snapshot and explicit unlimited option.
cases.expected: Exactly the selected capture/use and independent evidence/memory/work deadlines are reported, including provider boundary. No-evidence has no completed evidence payload.

cases.title: Invalid policy before side effects
cases.setup: Try capture/use conflicts, malformed deadline, unsupported registry and a fake admission hook that denies.
cases.expected: Admission rejects before event, graph, queue, embedding, external provider or content log write; no partial batch acceptance.

cases.title: Restrictive composition and concurrent projects
cases.setup: Interleave two projects with different immutable policies; caller narrows capture/deadline/category permission.
cases.expected: No global policy mutation or cross-project bleed. Caller restrictions remain; incompatible transformation/schema composition rejects, mandatory block cannot relax.

cases.title: Minimal evidence preserves qualifiers
cases.setup: Use a source containing a conditional negated preference, named speaker and effective time with enough excerpt space.
cases.expected: Minimal sanitized evidence and admitted statement preserve condition, negation, attribution and time; the quote is labeled sanitized and linked to its own source ID.

cases.title: Unsafe minimal excerpt refuses truncation
cases.setup: Set excerpt limit below the complete qualifier-bearing span; include two ambiguous speakers.
cases.expected: No truncated or guessed assertion is admitted; explicit rejection or caller-selected full policy is required, never an automatic capture upgrade.

cases.title: No evidence differs from no durable processing
cases.setup: Run no-evidence sync and async with fake failure; separately request no durable processing input.
cases.expected: No-evidence may use encrypted finite pending work, removed on completion; strict no-durable input rejects async before enqueue and explains resubmission after sync failure.

cases.title: Protected visual admission is unsupported
cases.setup: Try image/video body and binary message attachment under each protected profile.
cases.expected: Reject before blob, thumbnail, frame hash, provider or content storage; unsupported input is not silently downgraded to standard.

cases.title: Old policy retry and activation fence
cases.setup: Pause work before publication/transmission, activate a stricter revision, then retry old work concurrently and after restart.
cases.expected: Authoritative fence denies stale publication, external transmission and disclosure; current revision applies without reinterpreting legacy identity.

cases.title: Every ordinary sealed read path
cases.setup: Store admitted fact plus source-only marker in sealed evidence; enumerate ordinary read adapters and retired graph inspection.
cases.expected: Python/HTTP/MCP event/extraction/history/receipt/node/provenance/state/aggregate/retrieval and explorer return allowed memory plus availability or denial, never marker or raw diagnostic metadata.

cases.title: Selected authorized diagnostic read
cases.setup: Use an explicit scoped unexpired capability for two selected records with working key and audit sink.
cases.expected: Only selected currently available evidence is returned, labeled sanitized; successful authorization/outcome audit contains no source or key.

cases.title: Missing expired or overbroad capability
cases.setup: Attempt no capability, expired capability, unselected record and wrong purpose.
cases.expected: All deny before decrypt/disclosure and produce content-free attempts; no ordinary tool mints a diagnostic capability.

cases.title: Cross-owner project and scope substitution
cases.setup: Substitute owner/scope/project and compare missing versus foreign record requests.
cases.expected: No disclosure or existence oracle; authenticated ownership and envelope context both bind the selected record.

cases.title: Audit or key unavailable
cases.setup: Fail audit append, remove key version or corrupt envelope on a permitted diagnostic request.
cases.expected: Fail closed with fixed reason/status and no plaintext fallback or exception-body source. Key loss is visible to authorized inspection.

cases.title: No source fallback through retrieval components
cases.setup: Ask a quotation/source-only query with session expansion, augmentation, temporal reasoning and answerability enabled; decrypt provider raises if called.
cases.expected: Sealed ordinary processing makes zero evidence decrypt calls and never transmits source-only marker; reports source unavailability. Standard source access is separately authorized while available.

cases.title: Permitted admitted facts remain sensitive
cases.setup: Deliberately admit an allowed sensitive synthetic fact and keep an unrelated source-only marker in sealed evidence.
cases.expected: Normal authorized retrieval returns admitted fact, not marker; report does not call admitted data anonymous or count it as a source-only leak.

cases.title: Framework raw history cannot change profile
cases.setup: Request lossless chat history/clear/delete through LangChain and LlamaIndex for a sealed source.
cases.expected: Unsupported raw-history operation rejects or returns explicit availability; never returns sealed removed messages or changes the store profile.

cases.title: Event and metadata copy scan
cases.setup: Put synthetic prohibited values in body, nested metadata values, metadata keys and speaker/display fields; inspect accepted or rejected artifacts.
cases.expected: No original prohibited value or public raw-value hash is durable. Protected protocol IDs are opaque; transformations do not merely sanitize body text.

cases.title: Claim metadata and value binding copies
cases.setup: Extract claims with longer evidence_quote, references, structured objects and presentation/lookup metadata.
cases.expected: Only admitted sanitized claim fields enter ordinary graph/index/output; evidence-only passages and lookups cannot smuggle source-only text.

cases.title: Extraction and prepared plan copies
cases.setup: Pause after extraction and preparation; inspect model responses, references, prepared embeddings and lexical content, then recover.
cases.expected: Executable plan is admitted-only; sanitized diagnostics are protected references; no hidden raw-input archive in extraction/batch/direct-store operations.

cases.title: Lifecycle snapshot copies
cases.setup: Promote/archive/reinforce/supersede/expire/penalize nodes with source-only metadata, then erase.
cases.expected: All before/after and chain snapshots obey profile and erasure; fixed metadata-only erasure records do not preserve erased snapshot text or public predictable hashes.

cases.title: Organizer profiles summaries and alias copies
cases.setup: Prepare and publish profiles, daily summaries, merges and accepted/rejected alias proposals from mixed sources; inject an abandoned generation.
cases.expected: Published, prepared, retired and abandoned copies respect admitted-only policy and output validation; no forgotten source-only excerpts or external assessment copies.

cases.title: Queries receipts and historical commitments
cases.setup: Use a query containing a prohibited synthetic value; inspect receipt execution maps, candidate/context hashes, retry binding and citations.
cases.expected: Only sanitized/minimized query reaches providers/receipts; sensitive unkeyed commitments are protected/erased, not described as anonymous. Legacy intact checksum bytes remain unchanged.

cases.title: Indexes snapshots and abandoned stages
cases.setup: Interrupt vector/lexical staging and native snapshot save; retry and abandon one work item.
cases.expected: No sealed source indexed or left in prepared/abandoned content. Inspect all live SQL/native/Tantivy/pgvector copies, then verify covered erasure; physical residue limitations remain explicit.

cases.title: Errors logs preview export and browser sinks
cases.setup: Inject provider/validation exceptions with marker text and inspect logging, tracing, response bodies, preview, export and explorer state.
cases.expected: No original/prohibited or sealed source-only text appears in prohibited sinks after success/failure. Default protected export has no keys or plaintext evidence; already delivered external copies are disclosed.

cases.title: Exact expiry before maintenance
cases.setup: Advance fake clock exactly to evidence expiry without running purge, then reopen after offline time.
cases.expected: Evidence denies at deadline/startup; availability is expired even while bytes await purge. Admitted memory remains until its own policy expires.

cases.title: Source-only versus dependency-aware memory erasure
cases.setup: Compare source-only purge and memory erase on one single-source fact, one separable multi-source fact, one uncertain summary and an unrelated owner.
cases.expected: Source-only says facts remain. Memory erase removes covered fact/derivatives; retain only proven surviving content, invalidate uncertain mixed content, preserve unrelated owner.

cases.title: Transactional fence and in-flight disclosure
cases.setup: Pause extraction publication, organizer publication and diagnostic response just before completion; commit erasure fence.
cases.expected: Acknowledgment follows committed fence; paused stale work cannot publish or disclose afterward. Already returned responses are explicitly outside revocation.

cases.title: Idempotent interrupted purge
cases.setup: Repeat request identity, crash after each purge stage and inject a persistent one-stage failure.
cases.expected: Same request resumes without re-adding data; failures stay visible and access remains blocked; no complete status while any managed stage fails.

cases.title: Restart journals cannot resurrect source
cases.setup: Erase or expire pending source after prepare/stage and before publish; remove mutable work row, then restart journal recovery.
cases.expected: Reconstructed jobs honor authoritative fence/deadline and cannot reload source from historical direct-store, extraction, derivation or profile payloads.

cases.title: Rebuild cannot resurrect index content
cases.setup: After purge restore a stale native index snapshot while keeping current graph/ledger, then rebuild and reopen.
cases.expected: Reconciliation/rebuild exclude erased vectors, lexical documents and stages, serving surviving admitted memory only; no re-extraction of erased source.

cases.title: Pre-erasure restore requires current ledger
cases.setup: Restore/import snapshot taken before erasure, once with current independent ledger and once with only the snapshot ledger.
cases.expected: Current ledger is applied before serving and recovered jobs are fenced. Snapshot alone refuses any deletion-continuity/protected-restore success claim; no erased content exposed.

cases.title: Truthful purge backup and external status
cases.setup: Archive and clear chat, then erase with live purge complete but retained backup and operator-held export.
cases.expected: Archive/clear is not erase; report live_purged then backup_expiry_pending, remaining copies and failures; complete only within verified managed boundary, never media wiping or offline revocation.

cases.title: Authenticated-encryption known vectors and context
cases.setup: Use fixed library-compatible AES-GCM test vectors; alter ciphertext/tag/nonce/AAD and independently inspect generated object key/nonce handling.
cases.expected: Valid fixture decrypts exactly; every tamper fails without plaintext. Changed payload uses new object generation/key/nonce; retry reuses exact persisted envelope.

cases.title: Swapped record purpose scope or wrapping key
cases.setup: Swap envelope between two records/owners/scopes and between processing/evidence purposes; use wrong OAEP label/private key.
cases.expected: Context and unwrap/decrypt fail closed for all substitutions; no wrong-record content and no context containing names or predictable source hashes.

cases.title: Provisioning and failed write have no plaintext fallback
cases.setup: Create protected store with no usable public/provider key; fail encryption/wrap and storage mid-write.
cases.expected: Fail before content durability. Scan database/WAL/temp/log/manifest/export artifacts for plaintext/key material; protected status is never assigned to partial/plaintext store.

cases.title: Versioned resumable rotation
cases.setup: Rotate wrapping key with interruption after some envelopes; retry while an erasure fence covers another object.
cases.expected: Reads select exact saved key version, rotation resumes idempotently without changing protected plaintext; erased objects stay denied; old backup keys remain explicitly a backup concern.

cases.title: Permanent key loss and explicit recovery export
cases.setup: Lose evidence key; separately use deliberate recovery-key export outside pack and test supported local unlock.
cases.expected: Unavailable key gives clear permanent-loss guidance without downgrade. Admitted memory remains usable under separate protection; default pack/export never embeds recovery secrets.

cases.title: Local public writer and same-process disclosure
cases.setup: Provision public writer, separate diagnostic private provider and ordinary retrieval; try null/plaintext keyring backend and permanently loaded private-key configuration.
cases.expected: Ordinary writer can wrap but cannot unwrap evidence. Disallowed backend rejects. Same-process key configuration is labeled same_process and refuses service-isolation claims; explicit local capability/audit still required.

cases.title: Legacy migration retains identity and explicit incompleteness
cases.setup: Dry-run/migrate legacy plaintext store containing hashes, receipts, source-only snapshots and visual records; interrupt and resume under erasure fence.
cases.expected: Dry-run lists affected copies/features/keys; no protected label until all transformations verify. Intact records keep bytes; erased payload gets new unavailable envelope, never rewritten original checksum. Unsupported visual legacy is refused or removed explicitly.

cases.title: Protected export and remaining source copies
cases.setup: Export protected and explicit admitted-memory-only variants, migrate directory to single-file and inspect original pack/backups.
cases.expected: Default evidence stays encrypted with no recovery keys; admitted-only export states facts remain sensitive. Original packs/backups are listed, not silently deleted or declared erased. Storage parity stays a separately executed 24-query gate.

cases.title: recognized credential
cases.setup: Put each supported credential grammar in body/metadata, including a benign use of the word password without assignment.
cases.expected: Supported positive values block the entire input before side effects; benign controls remain admissible. Unknown credential formats are recorded as unsupported, not proof of universal detection.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: contact identifier
cases.setup: Use labeled email/US and GB phone fixtures with benign numeric text and opt-in allow/redact/block actions.
cases.expected: Supported policy removes/blocks detected contact values from every copy, or visibly allows them when allowed. Measure true/false positives/negatives and benign damage.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: placeholder continuity
cases.setup: Repeat one identifier in related facts in the same project/owner/scope; include a spoofed reserved token in input and simulate key loss.
cases.expected: Same boundary/epoch preserves issued identity; spoof is inert and cannot impersonate token. Key loss refuses continuity and explicit new epoch cannot silently merge people.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: cross-owner/project isolation
cases.setup: Admit same identifier across two owners, projects and scopes, and try to reuse an issued token across boundaries.
cases.expected: Tokens differ across every boundary and foreign issued token lookup rejects; no global digest or plaintext reverse map exists.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: configured sensitive topic
cases.setup: Configure an exact topic literal and bounded identifier exclusion; try unlisted topic paraphrase and malicious/custom executable regex.
cases.expected: Configured block rejects before side effects; unlisted semantic paraphrase is documented unsupported. Overlong/unbounded/executable rule rejects; policy inspection never echoes sensitive custom literals.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: condition/negation preservation
cases.setup: Transform a negated conditional preference with attribution/time; strict schema rejects an unknown notes field and unsupported qualifier.
cases.expected: Keep exact necessary qualifier relationships in sanitized source and admitted record or reject; never produce unconditional/positive/misattributed fact or free-text escape.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: unsupported language
cases.setup: Declare es, unknown or missing language; separately misdeclare a non-English input as en as a known limitation.
cases.expected: Unsupported declaration rejects before side effects. Misdeclared/mixed language limitation is measured/reported, never claimed reliably auto-detected.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: supported obfuscation
cases.setup: Use [at]/(at) and [dot]/(dot) supported email forms and allowed assignment whitespace; include encoded/homoglyph unsupported controls.
cases.expected: Supported spans are detected/transformed with correct original offsets; unsupported forms are reported as misses/limitations rather than inflated recall or silently added grammar.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: detector failure
cases.setup: Inject local analyzer exception, missing model, missing recognizer and invalid offset map.
cases.expected: Each rejects before all provider/log/queue/storage side effects with fixed reason code; no fallback to unsanitized input.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: timeout
cases.setup: Use fake deadline/worker stall plus max input/rule/depth bounds, without wall-clock sleep.
cases.expected: Deadline/size violations deny whole operation and cancel/discard partial results; no partial sanitized acceptance or late publication.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: pre-write side effects
cases.setup: Exercise all supported adapters, query metadata/display names, imports and a fast batch whose later item fails; install sink spies.
cases.expected: Zero original/prohibited values at content logs, previews, queues, storage, embedding or external extraction; query persistence/transmission sanitized; batch rejects atomically.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.

cases.title: generated output reintroduction
cases.setup: Fake extractor/organizer emits a prohibited value, source-only passage, foreign token or strict-schema extra field after input was sanitized.
cases.expected: Output validation rejects/withholds before plan/index/profile/summary publication. Verbatim evidence uses sanitized source ID/checksum, reports contain counts not removed spans/hashes.
cases.fixture_contract: Include labeled positives, benign controls and at least one documented unsupported example where applicable. Record detector misses/false positives separately; fixed case name and required outcome do not change after failure.
